scope: Static native x86-64 frozen ordinary Release CLI code paths; no target execution or allocation/timing inference.
limits: This is the concrete Array caller path; generic fallbacks also remain.
Comparator dispatch through supplied helper pointers remains indirect; it is not fully inlined/devirtualized.
Candidate retains three observed uniqueness check sites and conditional whole-buffer copy fallbacks; baseline retains one observed site. Counts describe these frozen bodies only.
Capacity helper allocates stride*requestedCapacity plus array header and uses allocator usable-size rounding; reserve is not an exact allocation-byte guarantee.
Reduced-result storage owns copied fixed-width values and releases sorted storage, but other input/sort/allocator storage remains. No dynamic allocation count, RSS savings or throughput is inferred.
